decisions.reason: This 2023 launch remains a close extension of the firm's core pallet-display business in a growing market, so a medium-sized specialist would usually retain it unless demand has clearly underperformed.

The online customer portal is relatively far from the firm's traditional physical-display offering, so it faces the highest rationalization risk, but it still fits the firm's move toward deeper customer collaboration and stronger information processes.
An award-winning cardboard packaging display solution strongly reinforces the firm's core capabilities and market credibility, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.
A quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display is closely aligned with the firm's standard retail-display business and is likely to be kept as part of its broadened 3D cardboard range.
The small cardboard counter display is a core-adjacent standard solution that suits the firm's customer base, though it carries a modest risk of pruning if volumes or margins prove weak.
The large freestanding cardboard information display fits the firm's established design, production, and assembly strengths, so management would normally keep it unless customer uptake falls short.
